## Catalog Description

Stochastic Dynamic Programming. (3-0). Credit 3. Methodologies for stage-wise stochastic-decision processes; includes finite-horizon models, infinite-horizon discounted total cost models, and average cost models; applications of methods to various situations. Prerequisites: ISEN 609 and ISEN 622, or approval of the instructor.

## Additional Course Details

This course introduces analytical and numerical tools for solving stochastic and deterministic dynamic optimization problems in discrete time. The course is centered around a Markov decision process (MDP) formulation of stochastic dynamic optimization. Bellman's equation and properties of the value function and of the optimal policy function are discussed for finite and infinite horizon problems. The course closes with a survey of reinforcement learning methods such as Q-Learning, policy gradient and actor-critic.

## Course Learning Outcomes

Upon completion of this course, the learner will be able to:

- Ability to formulate and analyze stochastic dynamic optimization problems.

- Ability to use of numerical and/or statistical techniques to identify optimal solutions.
